title: 1082792 identity chain verified: the executive summary's researched HOTU 87.0% row and snapshot.json's unresolved record are two layers of the same publish
detail: The deployed executive summary prices Hotspawn fixture 1082792 (HOTU vs The Huns, Moscow Cyber Games 2026, 2026-10-31T09:00:00Z) at HOTU 87.0% / The Huns 13.0%, badged 'Researched' + 'Market line', cited to Polymarket event cs2-hotu-the9-2026-10-31. The same publish's snapshot.json records the identical fixture with analysis null, pick_index null and featured.unresolved 1. Read first-hand through the platform page fetcher, the chain holds across three independent sources: Hotspawn 1082792 starts 2026-10-31T09:00:00Z; Polymarket event 1241313 has eventStartTime 2026-10-31T09:00:00Z and outcomes 'HOTU'/'The Huns Esports' in the Moscow Cyber Games Playoffs Semifinal 1; HLTV match 2399437 is 'HOTU vs. The Huns at GLuck Moscow Cyber Games 2026', Best of 3 (LAN), Semi-final. The featured exact-name layer is unresolved only because it does not silently alias 'The Huns Esports' to 'The Huns' or Polymarket's 'the9' slug. The row is a prediction-market money line, not a Hotspawn crowd percentage and not an HLTV fan vote. No number was changed.

title: Nine open Hotspawn CS2 fixtures are absent from the deployed snapshot (a dated gap, not a collector defect)
detail: At 2026-10-26T00:48-00:50Z the live Hotspawn CS2 lobby lists 19 open fixtures and the scheduled-fixtures API returned records through index 81, while the deployed snapshot (generated 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z; its own inventory recorded 72 records at 23:03:30Z) serves 10 upcoming. The nine the snapshot does not serve are 1079201, 1081159, 1079202, 1081160, 1079203, 1093218 (NODWIN Clutch Series #13) and 1081162, 1081163, 1081164 (CCT Europe 2026 Series #12). All are tier b, lock_offset_sec 360, offered_points 3, and carry very low Hotspawn total_picks (2-8 vs 39-49 on covered fixtures) - exactly the low-tier fixtures the brief requires to still get a pick. scripts/collect.py reads the fixture API wholesale with no client pagination and no date-window filter, so the collector cannot have dropped them; the snapshot's inventory read 72 at 23:03:30Z and the API returned more at 00:50Z, so they were added to Hotspawn's schedule between those reads. The four-hour publisher re-collects on every refresh; a publisher run was in flight when this was recorded.

title: Executive summary headline counts 10 priced picks and 0 unresolved; snapshot.json's featured layer counts 9 picked and 1 unresolved
detail: The landing-page headline reads '10 active Hotspawn CS2 fixtures in this snapshot, 10 with a directional pick ... and 0 explicitly unresolved'. The same publish's snapshot.json records featured.picked 9 and featured.unresolved 1, where the unresolved fixture (1082792) is priced in the executive summary through the researched complete layer. The summary does disclose the split ('the featured exact-name method left 1 fixture(s) without a pick. Each now carries a researched estimate from a named source'), so the two numbers describe different layers of one publish, but a reader comparing the headline with snapshot.json sees two different unresolved counts.

title: The 'Hotspawn best-of format is unverified' limitation on 1082792 is true of Hotspawn's payload but not of the fixture
detail: snapshot.json records 'Hotspawn best-of format is unverified; left blank.' for 1082792. Hotspawn's payload sends best_of null and series_format null for every current fixture, so the limitation is true of the record. It is not true of the fixture: Polymarket publishes event 1241313 as '(BO3)' and HLTV match 2399437 lists 'Best of 3 (LAN)'. Left as a labelled limitation rather than filled in; flagged so the wording can be made precise.
